sources.snippet: Install Download HexAnima-<version>.apk from the Releases page and install it (allow installs from your browser or file manager). Open the app and pick a model in Models. The files are downloaded from Hugging Face (ayanoby/anima-npu-packs) the first time. Type a prompt (Danbooru-style tags work best), press Generate.
